title: PRISM-BENCH: Diagnosing Grounded and Faithful Multimodal Reasoning Beyond Final-Answer Accuracy
summary: Final-answer accuracy reports whether a vision-language model was right, but not whether its answer was grounded in the image, whether its stated reasoning reflects that evidence, or what the answer cost to produce. Those are the properties that decide whether a system can be deployed. We present PRISM-BENCH, a benchmark of 1,000 expert-curated questions spanning five under-represented reasoning categories, in which every item carries an idealized reasoning trace written by one human annotator and validated by another. The traces support two diagnostics that accuracy cannot provide. A perception probe, in which the model answers from a description it wrote itself, attributes roughly 85% of frontier-model failures to misperception and places the bottleneck at grounding. Trace alignment predicts answer correctness for all 25 systems tested (macro AUROC 0.66) and survives length control, so it measures reasoning content and not verbosity. We further introduce CORE, an efficiency-aware metric that reorders 24.2% of model pairs relative to accuracy while remaining uncorrelated with response length. Across 25 open and closed systems, including GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4.6, the best accuracy is 66.0%. On the four categories with a human baseline the best system trails humans by 18.4 points, and recent frontier gains fall on recognition and not on spatial grounding.
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment (VLM4RWD). 18 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Dataset: this https URL

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PRISM-BENCH，一个包含 1000 道专家构造视觉语言推理题的基准，并通过人工理想推理轨迹提供可解释诊断；研究发现模型错误主要源于视觉感知与空间定位不足，且轨迹一致性和效率感知指标 CORE 比准确率更能刻画可部署性。
AI.motivation: 仅报告最终答案正确率无法判断视觉语言模型的回答是否真正基于图像证据、其推理陈述是否与证据一致，以及产生答案的计算或输出成本是多少；这些属性决定模型是否可靠、可解释并可部署。
AI.method: 构建 PRISM-BENCH：1000 道覆盖五类代表性不足推理任务的专家题集，每个问题配有一条由人工撰写并经另一人验证的理想推理轨迹。利用该轨迹设计两类诊断：一是感知探针，让模型基于自己生成的图像描述回答问题，以区分感知错误与推理错误；二是轨迹对齐，用模型推理与理想轨迹的一致性检验其是否真正反映证据；同时提出效率感知指标 CORE，在准确率之外引入成本/效率信息。在 25 个开源与闭源模型上评测，包括 GPT-5 和 Claude Opus 4.6，并与人类基线比较。
AI.result: 感知探针显示约 85% 的前沿模型失败可归因于错误感知，瓶颈在图像定位而非高层推理。轨迹对齐能预测答案正确性，宏平均 AUROC 为 0.66，并在控制长度后仍成立，说明其反映推理内容而非冗长度。CORE 指标相对准确率重新排列了 24.2% 的模型比较结果，且与响应长度无关。25 个系统中最高准确率为 66.0%；在有四项人类基线的类别中，最佳模型仍落后人类 18.4 分。近期前沿模型进步主要出现在识别类任务，而非空间定位类任务。
AI.conclusion: PRISM-BENCH 和 CORE 揭示了最终准确率掩盖的关键问题：当前视觉语言模型的主要瓶颈是感知与空间定位，而非单纯的答案生成或文本长度；理想的推理轨迹可作为诊断工具，效率感知指标应被纳入模型部署评估。

title: LearnPrunerV2: Learnable Progressive Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal capabilities but suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to the massive number of visual tokens. While token pruning is a promising solution, existing methods still suffer from two major drawbacks: 1) unreliable pruning criteria that fail to accurately localize task-specific regions due to inherent attention biases or query-agnostic designs, and 2) suboptimal pruning strategies that employ rigid, non-adaptive schedules, overlooking the dynamic evolution of token redundancy across different model depths. To address these challenges, we propose LearnPrunerV2, which extends the previous two-stage heuristic framework (LearnPruner) into a fully learnable architecture. Specifically, we integrate lightweight learnable modules into every layer of the VLM backbone, which estimate token importance by fusing intrinsic visual saliency with extrinsic query relevance captured via a shadow token. By uncovering a consistent staircase redundancy pattern across VLM layers, we further introduce Budget-Deterministic Pruning (BDP) to establish a hardware-friendly schedule with fixed per-layer budgets. Extensive experimental results across various benchmarks and VLMs demonstrate that LearnPrunerV2 consistently outperform previous state-of-the-art methods. Notably, LearnPrunerV2 preserves 99.8% of the original performance when pruning 77.8% of visual tokens on LLaVA-v1.5, achieving a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LearnPrunerV2，一种面向视觉语言模型的可学习视觉 token 剪枝框架，通过逐层学习 token 重要性并采用固定预算剪枝策略，在大幅减少计算开销的同时保持极高模型性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽然具备强大的多模态能力，但由于视觉 token 数量庞大，推理计算开销过高。现有 token 剪枝方法存在两类问题：一是剪枝依据不可靠，容易受注意力偏差影响或忽略具体视觉问答任务需求，导致无法准确保留任务相关区域；二是剪枝策略僵化，不能适应模型不同深度中 token 冗余度的动态变化，整体剪枝效果次优。
AI.method: LearnPrunerV2 将先前两阶段启发式框架 LearnPruner 扩展为完全可学习架构。具体地，作者在视觉语言模型主干的每一层中引入轻量级可学习模块，用于估计每个视觉 token 的重要性。重要性估计同时融合两方面信息：内在视觉显著性，以及与当前文本查询相关的外在相关性；其中查询相关性通过一个“shadow token”进行捕获和建模。此外，作者发现 VLM 各层存在一致的阶梯状冗余模式，并据此提出 Budget-Deterministic Pruning，即每层采用固定、硬件友好的剪枝预算调度，避免动态或手工设定剪枝率带来的不稳定性与实现复杂度。
AI.result: 在多个基准和多种视觉语言模型上的实验表明，LearnPrunerV2 持续优于现有先进方法。特别是在 LLaVA-v1.5 上，当剪除 77.8% 的视觉 token 时，仍保留原始模型 99.8% 的性能，展示了优异的准确率与效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: LearnPrunerV2 通过逐层可学习的重要性评估、查询感知的 token 选择机制以及基于层间冗余规律设计的固定预算剪枝策略，有效提升了视觉 token 剪枝的可靠性与效率，为大规模 VLM 推理加速提供了一种更具实用价值的方案。

title: Multibranch Ensemble Head in Vision Foundation Models for Efficient Cucumber Phenological Stage Classification
summary: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) pretrained with self-supervised learning, such as DINOv2, provide highly transferable features, yet adapting them to small, domain-shifted datasets is still challenging. We propose a regularizing multibranch ensemble head: a training and inference scheme that pairs low- and high-capacity branches, samples a single branch stochastically at each training step, and averages both branches in probability space at inference. The design adds negligible parameters and essentially no inference overhead over a single heavy head, while improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off under data-scarce conditions. Accurate classification of plant growth stages is critical for precision agriculture, enabling timely decisions on fertilization, irrigation, and harvesting. Therefore, as a challenging practical case we use cucumber phenological stage classification, in which flowers and fruits are frequently occluded by foliage, and stage transitions manifest primarily as subtle changes in leaf morphology. The NALEF Food Safety dataset contains images of five cucumber growth stages captured under diverse real-world conditions. On it we evaluate a broad range of backbones, including DINOv2 and DINOv3 ViT and ConvNeXt variants, against strongly supervised counterparts (ResNet, EfficientNet, ViT). The proposed DINOv2 ViT-S with multibranch head achieves a Macro F1 of 0.978 and Cohen's Kappa of 0.971, matching the performance of models more than ten times larger in parameters and GFlops, while requiring only 12.2 GFlops and 22.3M parameters, making it deployable on smartphones and edge devices for phenological stage classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于视觉基础模型小域适配的“正则化多分支集成头”，在低容量与高容量分支之间进行训练时随机采样、推理时概率平均，几乎不增加推理开销，却显著提升了数据受限条件下黄瓜物候期分类的精度与效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 自监督预训练视觉基础模型（如 DINOv2）具有较强可迁移性，但将其适配到小规模且存在域偏移的数据集仍然困难。植物生长阶段识别在精准农业中非常重要，但黄瓜物候期分类面临叶片遮挡、花果遮挡以及阶段差异主要体现在叶形细微变化等挑战，因此需要一种高效、低开销且适合移动端部署的适配方法。
AI.method: 论文提出一种正则化多分支集成头。该结构同时包含低容量分支和高容量分支：训练过程中每个优化步随机采样一个分支进行更新，从而起到正则化作用；推理阶段则在概率空间中对两个分支的输出进行平均。整体设计新增参数很少，并且相对于单个重分类头几乎没有额外推理开销。实验基于 NALEF Food Safety 数据集中五种黄瓜生长阶段图像，比较了 DINOv2/DINOv3 ViT 与 ConvNeXt 等自监督基础模型 backbone，以及 ResNet、EfficientNet、ViT 等强监督模型，并评估 Macro F1、Cohen's Kappa、参数量和 GFlops 等指标。
AI.result: 在黄瓜物候期分类任务中，DINOv2 ViT-S 结合所提多分支集成头取得了 Macro F1 0.978、Cohen's Kappa 0.971 的结果。该配置仅使用 22.3M 参数和 12.2 GFlops，却能够匹配参数量和计算量大十倍以上模型的分类性能，体现出较好的精度—效率权衡，并适合部署在智能手机和边缘设备上。
AI.conclusion: 对于自监督视觉基础模型在小规模、域偏移农业图像数据上的适配，正则化多分支集成头是一种轻量且有效的策略。它不显著增加推理成本，却能提升有限数据条件下的分类性能，使小模型达到接近大模型的效果，从而支持精准农业场景中的端侧实时物候期识别。

title: GCSR-OCC: Geometry Calibration and Semantic Routing for Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction represents scene geometry and semantics in a unified voxel grid, enabling recognition beyond predefined categories. One approach reconstructs scenes with 3D Gaussians and converts them into voxel occupancy. However, Gaussian scale inflation and excessive overlap can distort voxel occupancy predictions, while semantic mixing can arise within Gaussians spanning multiple categories and during 3D--2D semantic feature alignment. We propose GCSR-OCC, which combines geometry calibration and multi-mode query-conditioned semantic routing for indoor occupancy prediction from a single RGB image. The Evidence-Conserving Gaussian-to-Occupancy operator (EC-G2O) uses kernel mass normalization, $p$-norm aggregation, and a learnable gain to suppress scale inflation and excessive local evidence accumulation while calibrating occupancy responses. Multi-mode Query-First Gaussian Semantic Routing (MM-QGSR) matches multiple semantic modes per Gaussian to text queries and aggregates query-specific evidence into voxels through a learnable text-conditioned router. Fine-grained subclass queries and smoothed semantic aggregation further refine voxel-level predictions. Without 3D semantic annotations, GCSR-OCC achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary occupancy prediction on Occ-ScanNet, with 63.31% geometric IoU and 27.44% semantic mIoU. It also reduces geometric aggregation latency from 19.76 ms to 12.88 ms. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GCSR-OCC，用于从单张 RGB 图像进行开放词汇 3D 占用预测。其核心是通过几何校准和高斯—占用转换抑制尺度膨胀与过度重叠，并通过多模式、文本查询条件化的语义路由缓解语义混合问题，从而在无 3D 语义标注条件下取得开放词汇占用预测的领先性能。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇 3D 占用预测需要统一表示场景几何与语义，并支持预定义类别之外的识别。基于 3D Gaussian 的场景重建再转为体素占用的方法存在两类问题：第一，Gaussian 尺度膨胀和过多重叠会导致体素占用概率被扭曲或局部证据过度积累；第二，单个 Gaussian 可能跨越多个语义类别，且三维与二维语义特征对齐过程会引入语义混合，使开放词汇识别不稳定。因此，论文希望同时改善几何占用校准和语义—文本对齐。
AI.method: 论文提出 GCSR-OCC，结合几何校准和多模式查询条件化语义路由。几何方面，提出 Evidence-Conserving Gaussian-to-Occupancy 算子 EC-G2O，利用核质量归一化、p-范数聚合和可学习增益，抑制 Gaussian 尺度膨胀与局部证据过度累积，并校准占用响应。语义方面，提出 Multi-mode Query-First Gaussian Semantic Routing，即 MM-QGSR，对每个 Gaussian 匹配多个语义模式并与其对应的文本查询关联，再通过可学习的文本条件路由聚合查询特定证据到体素；同时引入细粒度子类查询和平滑语义聚合以进一步细化体素级预测。
AI.result: 在 Occ-ScanNet 上，GCSR-OCC 不使用 3D 语义标注即可实现开放词汇占用预测的 state-of-the-art 性能，几何 IoU 达到 63.31%，语义 mIoU 达到 27.44%。此外，几何聚合延迟从 19.76 ms 降低到 12.88 ms，表明方法在效率和占用预测质量上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: GCSR-OCC 证明了在高斯表示转体素占用过程中，针对尺度膨胀、证据累积和跨类别语义混合进行显式校准与查询条件化路由是有效的。该方法在开放词汇设置下无需 3D 语义标注也能获得更强的几何和语义占用预测能力，并提升聚合效率，为单 RGB 图像室内场景理解提供了实用方向。

title: 3D-SceneQ: Empowering 3D LLM With Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning and Multi-Modal Feature Enhancement
summary: Current 3D scene understanding pipelines typically concatenate vast numbers of 3D object tokens with text tokens and feed the resulting sequence to a Large Language Model (LLM). However, existing 3D-LLMs for scene understanding encounter two major limitations: (i) excessive inclusion of task-irrelevant object data, introducing noise that reduces reasoning accuracy and increases hallucinations; and (ii) reliance solely on point cloud data, which inherently lacks the rich semantic information available in complementary 2D modalities, such as color, material properties, texture, and high-level contextual relationships. To address these challenges, we introduce 3D-SceneQ, a 3D LLM that unifies adaptive token pruning with multimodal semantic enrichment, markedly advancing scene understanding, reasoning, and grounding. Specifically, we propose a Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP) module that adaptively selects task-relevant objects based on the intended meaning of user instructions, leveraging a learnable latent query to retain critical information while effectively suppressing irrelevant noise. In addition, we introduce a Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement (MOFE) module, which integrates 2D feature embeddings from pre-trained models into 3D representation to enrich object-level semantic information. Evaluations show that 3D-SceneQ outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks (e.g., +5.7 CIDEr on Scan2Cap and +17.0 EM@1 on SQA3D), demonstrating its remarkable capabilities in various 3D language reasoning tasks.
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Published in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia

AI.tldr: 本文提出3D-SceneQ，通过任务相关的自适应对象筛选和2D多模态语义增强，提升3D-LLM的场景理解、推理与定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-LLM常把大量3D对象token与文本token拼接输入LLM，导致两类问题：一是包含大量任务无关对象，引入噪声、降低推理准确率并增加幻觉；二是主要依赖点云，缺少2D图像中的颜色、材质、纹理及高层上下文等丰富语义信息。
AI.method: 3D-SceneQ联合引入两个模块：1）Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning（QGAP），根据用户指令的意图，利用可学习的潜在查询自适应筛选任务相关对象，保留关键信息并抑制无关噪声；2）Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement（MOFE），将预训练模型提取的2D特征嵌入融合到3D对象表示中，增强对象级语义。
AI.result: 在多个3D语言基准上取得优于现有SOTA的结果，例如在Scan2Cap上CIDEr提升5.7，在SQA3D上EM@1提升17.0，显示其在多种3D语言推理任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，结合任务相关的token剪枝与跨模态对象级语义增强，可以有效缓解3D场景理解中的噪声、低语义覆盖和推理不稳定问题，显著促进场景理解、推理与定位。

title: VideoLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning over Grounded Video Evidence
summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially advanced video understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, language-based reasoning traces do not provide a reliable mechanism for models to revisit relevant visual evidence, leading to visual forgetting and impairing their ability to reason over video content. Existing approaches maintain visual grounding during reasoning in two main ways: they either refer to evidence using textual coordinates, which specify symbolic locations rather than the visual content itself, or reinsert cropped regions or frames into the multimodal context, preserving visual details at the cost of substantial context expansion. To address these limitations, we introduce VideoLVR, which constructs latent visual evidence from local regions at relevant video moments, thereby providing visual support for intermediate reasoning steps. To supervise latent visual evidence generation, we introduce a visual token prediction objective that formulates visual token reconstruction as prediction over a vocabulary derived from the input video, thereby unifying visual evidence reconstruction and text generation within the same token prediction framework. This shared prediction framework enables MLLMs to reason over interleaved text tokens and latent visual states while integrating evidence from different moments. We further extend VideoLVR to reinforcement learning by treating sampled visual tokens as actions alongside text tokens and jointly optimizing the policy using final-answer rewards. By efficiently revisiting task-relevant visual information during reasoning, VideoLVR improves video understanding without substantially expanding the multimodal context. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness, especially on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VideoLVR，通过在多模态大语言模型推理过程中构造可学习的“潜在视觉证据”，让模型能够高效回看视频关键区域，从而缓解视频理解中的视觉遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频多模态大语言模型常使用链式思维进行推理，但纯语言推理轨迹难以可靠地回溯相关视觉证据，容易导致视觉遗忘。已有方法要么使用文本坐标描述证据位置，缺少真实视觉内容；要么将裁剪区域或帧重新插入上下文，保留视觉细节但会显著增加上下文长度和计算负担。
AI.method: VideoLVR在视频相关时刻的局部区域上构造潜在视觉证据，为中间推理步骤提供视觉支持。作者提出视觉token预测目标，将视觉token重建转化为基于输入视频派生词表的预测任务，使视觉证据重建与文本生成统一在同一token预测框架下。模型因此可以在文本token和潜在视觉状态之间交错推理，并整合不同时刻的证据。进一步地，该方法被扩展到强化学习：将采样的视觉token与文本token共同视为动作，并以最终答案奖励联合优化策略。
AI.result: 在多个视频理解基准上的实验表明，VideoLVR能够在不显著扩展多模态上下文的情况下，更高效地回看任务相关视觉信息，提升视频理解性能，尤其在需要细粒度视觉证据的任务上表现更明显。
AI.conclusion: VideoLVR通过将潜在视觉证据纳入推理过程，并用统一token预测框架和强化学习目标进行训练，有效缓解了视频MLLM中的视觉遗忘问题，为长视频和细粒度视频推理提供了更高效的视觉回溯机制。
